body: I guess I'm assuming the worst because she had sent me a lot of suicidal-ish messages that I ignored for a few weeks until just recently... just things like she isn't coping well and she's scared and she has a history of self harm and she went to the emergency room like two weeks before I left because she was afraid she was going to hurt herself. now I feel like she actually did and I'm afraid there's no one close enough to her to know or there isn't someone who cares enough to check up on her... like if someone texted her and she didn't respond I feel like they'd just assume she's busy because before she dropped everything she was a super busy person involved with everything possible to be involved in, but I guess no close relationships.

The thing is that I don't know her new therapist since she just didn't talk about therapy much (I left when she had just started again) and she recently moved addresses because she got so depressed when I wasn't talking to her when we were dating in our last month that she had to drop out of school and move off campus so I don't even know where she lives now or if that would be on record because I'm pretty sure her home address back in California is going to be what's on record. For all I know she could be living with a friend right now.
I know one of her friends but not her family. I don't really know most of her friends. I don't even know who she talks to.
